name: Glimmet
description: Glimmet, the Ore Pokémon. Able to evolve into Glimmora. A Rock and Poison type.
pokedex_entries: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.
